meta.goal: Drive the ENTIRE JS/TS npm ecosystem surface to a terminal verdict in-sandbox. Deep + thorough: each item's EVERY surface, never surface-level. Do not stop until every surface is live or deferred and we are ~90% confident the whole ecosystem is usable in the sandbox.
meta.live_means: proven in-sandbox through the REAL pipeline (Npm.install_tree -> Compilers.esbuild_bundle_dir -> JsEngine.run_program, or the relevant lane) + a skip-guarded test + recorded here and in FORGE-CAPABILITIES.md
meta.deferred_means: empirically blocked in-guest; record the WALL (bedrock|bridge|forge) + the concrete reason + any host-broker escape. Deferred is a terminal verdict too — it counts as 'covered'.
meta.engine: JsEngine.run_program/2 = StarlingMonkey default + QuickJS thin fallback (SM lacks regex \p{}; QJS lacks WebCrypto).
meta.walls: bedrock = no native exec in guest (V8 JIT, .node addons, child_process spawn) -> only via trusted host-service broker. bridge = browser/DOM-bound. forge = toolchain gap we can build from source.
meta.git: PATH-SPECIFIC commits only (concurrent worker shares repo). Never git stash / git add -A.
meta.loop: 2-min cron; each tick drives ONE next pending surface to a terminal verdict, deeply, then commits. Multitask within a tick when cheap.
meta.known_ceiling: Bundles ~10MB+ (e.g. full typescript) exceed the SM eval-host string / QuickJS wasm runtime limit. Most libs are well under; tree-shaking + minify helps. Filed under lib-ast.

items.item: async / event-loop in the eval host
items.note: async @bootstrap awaits eval result + StarlingMonkey event loop; clocks enabled (setTimeout); async-aware console_capture drains macrotasks. js_async_test: await/timer/promise-chain/stream all green.
path/url/querystring/string_decoder/assert via node_polyfills preset (alias->pure-JS polyfill)
events/util/Buffer(global)/stream all LIVE (stream needed the async event-loop, now fixed)
crypto-browserify polyfill (in node_polyfills map): createHash/createHmac/randomBytes/pbkdf2Sync proven
fs->memfs in node_polyfills map (IN-MEMORY fs): sync API + named imports + fs/promises (async) proven (js_fs_test). Host-FS access = separate broker concern (note).

Raw TCP/UDP (net/dgram) unresolvable — no socket syscall in the eval-host guest; only fetch (HTTP) is brokered. Escape: host-brokered socket (js_dock-style, like fetch). No pure-JS alternative (TCP needs a socket).
process shim banner (platform/env/argv/cwd/nextTick); os via os-browserify
zlib->browserify-zlib in node_polyfills map: gzip/gunzip + deflate/inflate roundtrips (js_zlib_test)
setTimeout/setInterval/setImmediate/queueMicrotask/process.nextTick all proven (js_async_test + banner shims; clocks enabled)

worker_threads unresolvable — no OS thread spawn in the single-threaded eval-host. Escape: host-brokered parallelism (fresh BEAM-process wasm instances = toolkit-isolation model). Sync compute works; true parallelism does not.
child_process unresolvable — no native exec in the wasm guest (the BEDROCK seal). Escape: trusted host-service broker; arbitrary native = rejected microVM tier.

native .node addons (sharp/better-sqlite3/native-bcrypt) cannot load in wasm. Escape: per-capability pure-JS/wasm alternative (better-sqlite3 -> in-tree sqlite.wasm; native bcrypt -> bcryptjs; many have JS equivalents). The native PACKAGE is terminal-deferred; the CAPABILITY often has an alternative.

WebAssembly absent in the StarlingMonkey eval-host (jitless SpiderMonkey-in-wasm cannot host a nested wasm engine in-guest; typeof WebAssembly=undefined, js_wasm_npm_test tripwire). So sql.js/@swc/wasm etc. that WebAssembly.instantiate a bundled .wasm cannot run via JS. ESCAPES: (1) host-brokered sibling wasm instance (intercept instantiate -> host wasmtime, flat-forest = toolkit-isolation model); (2) use the capability via our Forge wasi lane instead (sql.js -> in-tree sqlite.wasm; @swc -> esbuild). Terminal.

real Node/V8 process — V8 JIT cannot run in the wasm guest (W^X). THE last roadmap item. Escape (the place that could help): a trusted host-side Node service brokered to the guest (run native Node on the host, broker calls across the Dock) — same pattern as fetch/exec brokers, trust the impl not the input.

FINAL.live_summary: Language (ES/TS/JSX/decorators/regex), modules (CJS/ESM/exports-map/dynamic-import/interop/JSON/circular/TLA/browser-field), Node builtins (path/buffer/stream/events/util/process/crypto/zlib/fs-in-memory/os/querystring/assert/url/timers), web platform (WebCrypto/fetch/URL/Streams/Blob/FormData/AbortController/encoding), async (await/promises/timers/streams), pkgmgr (resolve/lockfiles x3/dep-types/overrides/monorepo), and 15 library categories (utilities/validation/dates/parsers/IDs/crypto/HTTP/AST-compilers/SSR/data/reactive/DOM/schema/text/templating).
